svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT BETA detailed field guide
svg.desc: Agent Beta creates one ignored local workspace per named bot, links reviewed access intent, and references canonical tasks without connecting a provider. This image also lists the exact folder, example prompt, CLI surfaces, five or six process steps, and role boundary.
svg.text: Named BOT and DOT workspace records
Set up a named workspace for Atlas.
Link only reviewed access intent to one task.
The named folder records scope and task references only.
It does not log in, launch a provider, or grant OS or API access.
